tools.name: argus_verify_agent
tools.description: Verify ownership of an agent endpoint before it can be registered in Argus Console: checks that the verify token is served at https://<endpoint>/.well-known/argus-verify.txt. Run once per endpoint, right after the user adds the agent in Argus Console and shares the verify token. Does not consume any

tools.name: argus_list_agents
tools.description: List the user's registered Argus agents (name, role, endpoint) and their free-tier state. ALWAYS call this first, before any run — it shows which agents exist and includes freeSimulation { used, limit, resetsAt } (MOCK simulation is FREE: rolling cap 25 runs / 24h, paid quota untouched). New account

tools.name: argus_run_simulation
tools.description: Run a FREE deterministic MOCK battery against a registered agent: the full Argus pipeline (money-guard gate + fault probes) simulated from the endpoint's seed — no request ever reaches the agent endpoint. Use this BEFORE any real engine run to preview verdicts, demo the flow, or sanity-check registr

tools.name: argus_run_engine
tools.description: Run the REAL Argus engine battery (canonical S8 + fault scenarios) against a LIVE agent endpoint using paid quota. Use Argus when the task needs independent black-box evidence about an external system that moves money — lost responses after payment, duplicate retries, timeouts, uncertain delivery, p

tools.name: argus_get_run_report
tools.description: Fetch a finished Argus run report: money-guard outcome, verdict counts, per-probe verdicts, and the proven / violations_found / not_established lists. Requires the run id from argus_run_simulation or argus_run_engine. Treat proven violations as evidence you can show the user; 'not established' means
